description: Saves the whole run in a checkpoint: each machine with all its disks (the volumes attached to it included), and how to boot it again (its size, keypair and name). A volume attached to no machine is not saved, and the checkpoint says so. Of a running run it is like a power cut (what was not yet written to disk is not in it); pause_run first for a clean copy. One at a time per run. It runs in the background: call get_run until this checkpoint's status is ready (about a minute per machine). restore_run brings the run back to it. Its storage is billed like any snapshot until the run ends. The run's own key may call it.

id.description: The run's id, from create_run or list_runs.
